title: Ultimate Lineup
next_chapter_hook: At the moment the oath was completed, an异变 occurred in the River of Destiny—Chen Tianming's silhouette flickered into existence.

text.content: When that transcendent gaze descended, Chen Ji felt the Tianji Record Fragment within him tremble violently, as if an ancient taboo was awakening from its slumber. He slowly closed his eyes, allowing the waves of the River of Destiny to wash over his consciousness—three breaths later, he opened his eyes, a faint smile curving his lips. "Since you wish to see, then look your fill." He murmured softly, yet his voice clearly reached everyone present, "By my decree—half an hour from now, the Chessboard of Heaven and Earth, oath assembly."

dialogue.content: Su Qingyao was the first to arrive at the Chessboard of Heaven and Earth. She stood three feet to Chen Ji's side, her gaze sweeping across the massive chessboard spanning heaven and earth. She said solemnly: "Are you certain you want to hold the oath ceremony here? The gaze of the Heavenly Eye has never left this area." Her tone carried worry, but it was interrupted by Chen Ji's next action—he turned to look at her, his eyes showing no trace of fear.

text.content: Under Chen Ji's urging, the Chessboard of Heaven and Earth slowly illuminated. The black and white pieces transformed into streams of light circling around. At the center of the chessboard, an ancient altar materialized from the void, upon which five daggers of varying designs were placed—the Oathswords forged from the power of destiny. "Precisely because it has been watching," Chen Ji said calmly, "I want it to see clearly what unity of purpose truly means."

dialogue.content: Ye Qing strode out of the void on demonic mist. The demonic energy churned around her, yet was suppressed by the chessboard's power into delicate patterns. When she looked at Chen Ji, a complex light flickered in her eyes: "Chen Ji, are you truly going to form an alliance with the Demonic Path? If this spreads, you'll have no place in the Tianqing Sect." Chen Ji laughed lightly upon hearing this: "Your Highness Saint Maiden, if the Tianqing Sect cannot accommodate me, then so be it."

Chen Nian's figure emerged from the shimmering waves of the River of Destiny. Her face had matured much from three years ago, yet more vicissitudes lingered between her brows. "Brother," she called softly, "I'm here." Chen Ji turned to look at his sister, a hint of tenderness flickering beneath his gaze. He stepped forward and gently patted her shoulder: "You've endured enough hardship all these years. From now on, your brother will no longer let you bear it alone."

text.content: Ling Yuan's figure appeared at the edge of the chessboard. Mists curled gently around him—that was the Tianqing Sect's secret art, the Heavenly Secrets Veiling Technique. He swept his gaze across everyone present before his eyes finally landed on Chen Ji: "This old man has lived for three thousand years, yet never seen such a lineup. Are you truly confident you can make these people follow you wholeheartedly?" Chen Ji met his gaze, answering calmly: "I seek no allegiance, only those who share my aspirations."

dialogue.content: Su Qingyao was the first to step onto the altar. Without hesitation, she took up the oath-sworn blade gleaming with cold light. The blade's edge sliced across her palm, blood dripping onto the符文 at the altar's center, instantly transforming into a streak of blue light that shot skyward. She stared directly at Chen Ji, solemnly declaring: "I, Su Qingyao, swear with my blood today—to follow Chen Ji for this entire life, to protect the Third Path, until the end of destiny."

Ye Qing accepted the second dagger. Gazing at her own reflection on the blade's surface, she suddenly let out a light laugh: "Who would have thought that I, the堂堂 Demonic Path Saint Maiden, would one day pledge a blood oath with a human." Without hesitation, she sliced open her palm. Her crimson demon blood resonated with the altar, transforming into purple-black light that intertwined beautifully with Su Qingyao's blue radiance. She proclaimed loudly: "I, Ye Qing, from this day forward advance and retreat with Chen Ji, share life and death."

Chen Nian was the third to step forward. Her oath-sworn blade was entirely different from the other four—the blade's surface flowed with golden power of destiny. She looked at her brother, eyes brimming with tears: "Brother, I was once the Lock-Key of Heavenly Fate, a tool they tried to use to suppress you. But from this moment, I am no longer anyone's key." Her voice trembled slightly, "I, Chen Nian, wish to stand shoulder to shoulder with you, to burn my heavenly fate for the Third Path."

Ling Yuan slowly ascended the altar, the mist trailing behind him like a long tail. As he picked up the dagger, he suddenly laughed heartily three times: "Good! Good! Good! This old man has waited for this day for three thousand years!" His laughter carried a hint of madness. "Chen Ji, today I shall tell you—what the Tianqing Sect owes me, I will reclaim with my own hands. And you, shall be my chosen successor!" His blood transformed into golden light, merging seamlessly with the first three pillars of light.

text.content: Just as the four lights were about to merge, ripples suddenly appeared at the edge of the Chessboard of Heaven and Earth. A虚幻 figure emerged from the ripples—an elderly man draped in gray robes, holding a feather pen, his features too blurred to distinguish, yet radiating an ancient presence. "The Fate Scribe," Chen Ji said calmly, "you arrive at the perfect time." The old man slightly bowed: "Grateful for Young Master Chen's acceptance, this old one wishes to use this remaining body to record this world-changing moment."

choice.prompt: The Fate Scribe requests to join the oath as an independent entity, Chen Ji needs to give a response.

choices.description: Though not a combatant, the Fate Scribe's control over destiny's power is irreplaceable—a key support for the final battle.
choices.visible_reward: The Fate Scribe will join the oath as an independent entity, gaining fate-level auxiliary support
choices.risk_hint: The Fate Scribe's stance is unclear, potential hidden dangers exist

text.content: Chen Ji gave a slight nod: "Since you're willing, stay." The Fate Scribe was overjoyed, bowed respectfully, then retreated to the altar's edge. As he moved, the feather pen in his hand traced through the air, actually recording the scene of this moment.

choices.description: Though useful, his origins are mysterious—perhaps keeping him independent could prove more valuable.
choices.visible_reward: The Fate Scribe will remain independent, providing unexpected assistance during the final battle
choices.risk_hint: May incur the Fate Scribe's grudge

text.content: Chen Ji calmly shook his head: "Not necessary. Just do your recording well." The Fate Scribe was slightly stunned, then revealed a meaningful smile as he silently stepped aside.

Chen Ji ascended the altar's final step. The five lights instantly gathered beneath his feet, lending him an aura as if he were the master of destiny. He surveyed his surroundings—the determination in Su Qingyao's eyes, the relieved smile of Ye Qing, Chen Nian's tearful gaze, Ling Yuan's maniacal laughter, and that eternally mysterious Fate Scribe. "Everyone," he began, his voice not loud yet clearly reaching each ear, "three days from now, when the River of Destiny runs dry, will be the day of final battle."

dialogue.content: Upon hearing this, Su Qingyao frowned slightly: "Three days? Why so hasty?" Chen Ji turned to look at her, a complex emotion flickering in his eyes: "Because the Heavenly Eye can no longer wait. It senses the threat, senses the power of our gathered forces." He paused, then continued, "Our time is running out. Before it fully awakens, we must take the initiative."

text.content: At this moment, the Chessboard of Heaven and Earth suddenly shuddered violently. The符文 at the altar's center began to flash intensely as five oath light pillars intertwined in the air, forming a massive formation. "This is..." Ling Yuan narrowed his eyes, "Heaven and Earth Witness!" Before his words finished, a巨大的 crack split open in the sky. An无形意志 reached out from the crack—that was the gaze of the Heavenly Eye, even more intense and oppressive than before.

choice.prompt: The Heavenly Eye's oppression descends, everyone awaits Chen Ji's reaction.

choices.text: Confront the Heavenly Eye's provocation directly
choices.description: Respond with the most defiant stance to the heavens' gaze, letting all see your determination and courage.
choices.visible_cost: Bear the Heavenly Eye's partial oppression
choices.visible_reward: Everyone's will is greatly inspired, fighting spirit rises

text.content: Chen Ji laughed heartily toward the sky, staring directly at that crack: "See this? These are your so-called pieces! We—do not live for you!" His voice transformed into tangible power, colliding head-on with the heavenly will. On the altar, the five light pillars suddenly surged, actually forcing that crack back by three inches.

choices.text: Hide true strength and respond calmly
choices.description: Avoid direct conflict with the heavens, resolve the pressure through wisdom, preserving trump cards for the final battle.
choices.visible_cost: Cannot fully unleash the oath's power
choices.visible_reward: Preserve strength, avoid premature exposure—the Heavenly Eye cannot see through your hidden cards

text.content: Chen Ji unhurriedly raised his hand. The five light pillars instantly gathered, transforming into five gleaming oath tokens that flew into the hands of their five holders. The Heavenly Eye's gaze fell upon the empty altar, as if confused where that power had gone. "Everyone, rest for three days," Chen Ji said calmly, "when the time comes for battle, we shall show this old thing true power."

The oath ceremony concluded perfectly. The Chessboard of Heaven and Earth slowly faded into the void as five oath tokens landed respectively in the hands of five core members. Su Qingyao, Ye Qing, Chen Nian, Ling Yuan, and that eternally silent Fate Scribe—they stood together, forming a complete circle. Chen Ji stood at the circle's center, feeling power gathering from all directions. At this moment, he was no longer the mockedtrash, but the leader of a coalition capable of shaking the heavens. "Three days later, at the place where the River of Destiny runs dry, we shall meet without fail." He said softly.

After everyone departed, Chen Ji stood alone where the Chessboard of Heaven and Earth had vanished, gazing up at the starry sky. The Tianji Record Fragment within him pulsed with gentle warmth—that transcendent gaze still existed, yet no longer filled him with fear. He knew the true trial was about to begin. And just then, from the direction of the River of Destiny, an异动 suddenly rippled through—a vague silhouette shimmering within the waves. The outline, the aura, it actually overlapped with a long-faded figure in Chen Ji's memory. "Father..." Chen Ji murmured, his eyes slightly reddening.
